name: Barnabas
overview: Barnabas, also known as Joses, is introduced in Acts as a Levite from Cyprus who exemplified generosity by selling land and laying the proceeds at the apostles' feet. His role as a man full of the Holy Spirit and faith is highlighted by his bold support of Saul (Paul) when others were fearful, bringing him to the apostles and vouching for his genuine conversion and preaching. Barnabas’s character as a son of consolation and a faithful disciple is foundational to the early church’s growth and unity.
